notes.title: Signal Intentions Full Release
notes.notes:
[h3]Features[/h3][list][*][p]Three modes of anomaly spotting[/p][/*][*][p]53 Anomalies split among the three modes[/p][/*][*][p]Localisation available for[/p][list][*][p]Simplified Chinese[/p][/*][*][p]Japanese[/p][/*][*][p]Portuguese – Brazilian[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Partial Controller Support[/p][list][*][p]Menu navigation using controller not fully supported at the moment[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][h3]Post-Launch Plan[/h3][p]As the game moves into post launch, the focus will shift into:[/p][list][*][p]Bug fixing[/p][/*][*][p]Fixing any performance issues[/p][/*][/list][p]So do send in any issues you face while launching or playing the game! As for content updates, I might do some free updates in the future in line with seasonal events such as Halloween. I might even do a VR version, if I have the time to do so.
[/p][p]Hope you all have some fun spotting the anomalies![/p]

notes.title: Signal Intentions v0.2.1 - Demo Update Available Now!
notes.notes: [h3]Signal Intentions v0.2.1[/h3][p]Hey all,[/p][p]As the development reaches the final stages, more updates to the demo has been added. Starting from this update, all patch notes will also be released here in the community hub to keep players updated! Final release date will be updated in the upcoming weeks, so stay tune![/p][p]In the meantime, do leave some feedbacks, and bug reports through the form linked in the main menu, the community hub, or simply email to play@headphoneturtlegames.com :)[/p][p][/p][h3]Summary[/h3][list][*][p]UI updates to chapter select[/p][list][*][p]Tab menu instead of a scroll view[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Added 5 more anomalies to demo chapter[/p][/*][*][p]Demo chapter updates [/p][list][*][p]Reduce to 8 levels for demo chapter[/p][/*][*][p]Added option to reset level to allow players to try to get all anomalies completed.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Bug fixes[/p][list][*][p]Interaction text not appearing some times[/p][/*][*][p]Settings and pause menu screen overlaps[/p][/*][*][p]Chapter select shows incorrect completion rate[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list]
